promptLatex: A point is chosen at random from inside a rectangle of width $10$ and height $6$. What is the probability that its distance from the left side of the rectangle is between $2$ and $5$?
hintLatex: Inside a rectangle the probability of a strip is the ratio of the widths.
The favourable strip is $5 - 2 = 3$ units wide out of a total width of $10$, and its height runs the full $6$ units.
solutionLatex:
A uniformly chosen point makes the probability the ratio of areas.

The favourable region is a vertical strip of width $5 - 2 = 3$ and height $6$, of area $18$. The rectangle has area $10 \cdot 6 = 60$.

Therefore $P = \frac{18}{60} = \frac{3}{10}$.
